Specify search parameters

specify_search_params.Rd

Configures library search options: search function, number of hits, threads, and scoring.

Usage

specify_search_params(
  type = NULL,
  hits = NULL,
  threads = NULL,
  ri_column_type = NULL,
  min_match_factor = NULL
)

Arguments

type

Character; search function type: "identity", "simple", "hybrid", or "neutral_loss".

hits

Integer; number of hits to return (default from options).

threads

Integer; number of threads for parallel search (default from options).

ri_column_type

Character; RI column type string (must be recognized by mspepsearchr).

min_match_factor

Integer; minimum match factor to report (default from options).

Value

Invisibly, previous option values.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
  specify_search_params(
    type = "hybrid",
    hits = 20L,
    threads = 4L,
    min_match_factor = 700
  )
} # }
